evidence: All fifteen tests use the public advantage-play-kit API and the public game-cartridges catalog boundary.
The tests preserve five scoped titles and do not add app-local APIs.
The empty catalog produces the intended Red boundary failures.
Each test checks manifest id and input mode before calling createGameConfig.
Each test supplies input, edition, complete, diagnostic, and inputController context fields.
Each test rejects a configuration without a Phaser scene entry.
The runtime factory forwards the same context fields to createGameConfig.
createGameConfig_context.note: The Red helper uses {} as RuntimeEdition. Green should replace this cast with a valid non-authoritative edition fixture.

evidence: Runtime selects vocabularyInputSchema or sentenceInputSchema from manifest.inputMode.
The fixtures use the canonical term and translation array shape.
Mechanics tests normalize every declared keyboard code to a bounded InputActionId.
No wrapper or legacy id field enters the cartridge input fixture.
Runtime validates cartridge completion through gameResultsSchema before host delivery.
Learning tests verify at-most-once completion through createCompletionLatch.
The shared runtime tests verify invalid results and exactly-once host delivery.
The Red tests do not execute a cartridge completion callback because the catalog is intentionally empty.
All five titles test compact 390x844 and wide 1440x900 compositions.
All five tests inspect geometry and require supported compact and wide profiles.
All five tests verify pause, gesture cancellation, recompose, state restore, diagnostics, and resume order.
The shared runtime exposes state capture and restoration without canvas recreation.
Each learning test rejects a wrong candidate without progress.
Each learning test advances every target in order and checks completion count.
Each learning test checks correct answers, attempts, accuracy, and score.
Each learning test checks one completion delivery.
The shared result-accounting tests own the detailed XP formula contract.
No Phase 3 test imports Phaser or a renderer implementation.
The renderer remains behind createPhaserGameFactory and GameFactory.
The tests assert only the Phaser-compatible scene configuration boundary.
The catalog remains empty and exposes no title loader.
All five Phase 2 dossiers remain candidate records with fifteen blocked decisions.
All selected asset unions are empty, whole-pack delivery is false, and fallback is none.
All five owner-acceptance records remain pending.
Phase 3 evidence explicitly grants no adoption, ingestion, implementation, cutover, or Green authority.

findings.title: Red context uses an invalid edition cast
findings.context: The tests pass {} as RuntimeEdition although the context contract requires a validated edition.
findings.impact: A Green cartridge may fail on fixture shape before its scene contract runs.
findings.recommendation: Use a valid test edition fixture without treating it as asset adoption evidence.

findings.title: Cartridge completion is deferred by the Red boundary
findings.context: The tests verify the shared latch but cannot observe a cartridge result while the public catalog is empty.
findings.impact: Green must prove the cartridge emits the five-field GameResults ABI.
findings.recommendation: Keep the current Red boundary and add a cartridge result assertion during Green.
